heading: Protection of balconies and verandahs
content:
3.
Protection of balconies and verandahs
(1)-(2)
(Repealed L.N. 439 of 1990)
(3)
Every balcony projected from an upper storey of a building shall have a clear height, upwards from the floor of such balcony, of not less than the clear height of the storey from which it projects.
(L.N. 406 of 1987)
